description: 경기도_소방_경찰_지구대_치안센터 현황 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도 내에 설치된 소방서, 경찰서, 지구대, 파출소, 치안센터 등 공공안전기관의 현황을 정리한 자료로, 각 시설의 명칭, 분류(경찰관서, 파출소 등), 위치정보(지번주소. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 소방서, 경찰서, 행정기구, 지구대, 파출소. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
